_comment: The Ink & Signal light-theme tokens from src/app/globals.css, as the documents need them. One source, because two renderers consume it: scripts/doc-kit.mjs builds the .docx templates and src/lib/documents/pdf renders the PDF, and a palette kept in two files drifts. Word and PDF have no notion of alpha on text or shading, so the translucent tokens are pre-composited onto white: --border rgba(21,21,28,0.1) becomes E4E4E8, --accent-soft rgba(18,119,217,0.1) becomes E8F1FB.
